description: This file contains implementation code for managing LED configuration via web interface. It includes functions for processing JSON and msgpack-encoded data, updating configuration files, schema validation, and handling different LED configuration sub-documents such as full config, brightness, and on/off states. It also handles versioning and resource cleanup.

methods.name: size_t webconf_ssid_timeout_handler(size_t numOfEntries)
methods.description: Calculates timeout based on number of entries, with hardware-specific conditions.

methods.name: int bytes_contain_zero(const msgpack_object_bin * bin)
methods.description: Checks if a msgpack string contains zero bytes, which is invalid for certain JSON conversions.

methods.name: size_t msgpack_object_print_jsonstr(char * buffer,size_t length,const msgpack_object o)
methods.description: Converts a msgpack object into a JSON string, handling various data types.

methods.name: int led_on_off_config_set(const char * buf,size_t len,pErr execRetVal)
methods.description: Parses and applies LED on/off configuration passed as a JSON string, with schema validation.

methods.name: pErr led_on_off_cfg_exec_handler(void * data)
methods.description: Executes applying the on/off configuration blob.

methods.name: int led_onOffBlobSet(void * data)
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded msgpack blob, parses it, and dispatches a request to apply on/off configuration.

methods.name: int led_brightness_config_set(const char * buf,size_t len,pErr execRetVal)
methods.description: Parses and applies LED brightness configuration passed as a JSON string, with schema validation.

methods.name: pErr led_brightness_cfg_exec_handler(void * data)
methods.description: Executes applying the brightness configuration blob.

methods.name: int led_brightnessBlobSet(void * data)
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded msgpack blob, parses it, and dispatches a request to apply brightness configuration.

methods.name: int led_full_json_config_set(const char * buf,size_t len,pErr execRetVal)
methods.description: Processes a full LED configuration JSON, validates against schema, and updates backup files and actual config files with safety measures.

methods.name: int led_fullJsonBlobSet(void * data)
methods.description: Handles decoding and processing of a full JSON blob for LED configuration.

methods.name: int led_cfg_rollback_handler()
methods.description: Performs rollback in case web configuration application fails, e.g., by restoring backup files.

methods.name: void led_cfg_free_resources(void * arg)
methods.description: Frees resources allocated for LED config blob data.

methods.name: uint32_t getLedMgrBlobVersion(char * subdoc)
methods.description: Retrieves the version number of a specific subdoc blob from PSM.

methods.name: int setLedMgrBlobVersion(char * subdoc,uint32_t version)
methods.description: Sets the version number of a specific subdoc blob in PSM.

methods.name: int web_config_init()
methods.description: Registers supported sub-documents and their version get/set callbacks for the LED web config management system.

ctags.name: led_brightness_config_set
ctags.pattern: /^int led_brightness_config_set(const char *buf, size_t len, pErr execRetVal)$/

ctags.pattern: /^int led_full_json_config_set(const char *buf, size_t len, pErr execRetVal)$/

ctags.pattern: /^int led_on_off_config_set(const char *buf, size_t len, pErr execRetVal)$/

ctags.pattern: /^size_t msgpack_object_print_jsonstr(char *buffer, size_t length, const msgpack_object o)$/
